name: Supply Chain Inventory Rebalancer
description: RL benchmark env for LLM supply chain planning

paragraphs: An advanced reinforcement learning environment for optimizing multi-warehouse inventory management with process supervision rewards. Designed for the OpenM hackathon.

This environment simulates a supply chain with three warehouses (east, central, west) managing five SKUs across 30-45 day horizons. Agents learn to minimize stockouts and costs through dynamic inventory transfers.
Traditional RL environments reward only final outcomes. This environment provides per-step intermediate signals to guide learning:
features: ✅ Process Supervision: Per-step intermediate rewards for multiple decision-quality signals ✅ Three Difficulty Levels: Progressive tasks from simple restocking to complex supply shocks ✅ OpenM Compatible: Structured…
Balance Signal (+0.5 if reducing inventory gaps)
Helps agent learn equilibrium strategies early
Model learns to interpret demand patterns
